answer: A bond is refunded only after 26 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The jade counter is kept in bridge and walnut exposes each reset. Anyone therefore has to keep each alias continuously active for 26 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2913 identities would post 4305 proofs and burn roughly 52 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
